defaultContent.title: Build a Successful Education Business with a Trusted Brand
defaultContent.lead: Own a premium preschool and school franchise with Dolphin Kids. Join a network focused on international learning practices, quality education, innovation and sustainable growth, with a model designed for flexibility, brand support and long-term growth potential.
defaultContent.disclaimer: For investors, this is an opportunity to evaluate, not a promise of results. Business success, enrolment and returns are not guaranteed and depend on your location, execution and market.

defaultContent.reasons_eyebrow: Why choose a Dolphin Kids franchise

reasons.title: Global demand from parents
points: Growing preference for international-quality early childhood education.
Increasing demand for structured preschool and primary education.
Internationally inspired curriculum and modern teaching methodologies.
Opportunity to serve parents seeking premium educational experiences.

reasons.title: Premium and higher fee structure
points: Opportunity to operate with a premium fee positioning.
Access to multiple programmes and value-added learning offerings.
Scope for diversified revenue through preschool, primary school, day care and extracurricular activities.
Flexible fee positioning based on location, infrastructure and market potential.

reasons.title: Flexible area franchise model
points: Franchise rights are associated with an approved geographical area.
Suitable for both owned and rented properties.
For rented premises, relocation may be permitted, subject to company approval.
Opportunity to retain franchise rights while changing location within the approved territory.

reasons.title: Established and diversified network
points: Become part of the Dolphin Kids franchise network across Pre-Nursery to Senior School, Day Care and ISMPA.
Benefit from shared knowledge, operational expertise and brand recognition.
Access standardised academic programmes and operational systems.
Explore multiple education formats under one brand.

reasons.title: Royalty structure: 10–25% from day one
points: Royalty applies from the first day of operations.
The applicable rate within the 10–25% range depends on the selected franchise model.
Commercial terms are defined under the franchise agreement.
Structured brand and academic support in accordance with the applicable package.

reasons.title: Flexible ownership and constitution
points: Flexibility to change the constitution of the franchise entity, subject to company approval.
Addition of business partners or directors permitted, subject to company approval.
Change in ownership may be considered, subject to the agreement.
Business continuity can be maintained through an approved transfer process.

reasons.title: Long franchise tenure: up to 7 years
points: Franchise agreement tenure of up to 7 years, subject to agreed terms.
Supports long-term business planning and operational stability.
Opportunity to establish and grow your educational institution over an extended period.
Renewal and continuation subject to the franchise agreement.
